The secretaries of the Department of Economic Affairs and the Department of Urban Development attended the meeting. The ministry's post gave no details of the proposals made by participants.

articles.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
articles.desc: India's Securities and Exchange Board is proposing crucial adjustments to governance norms affecting market institutions. Key suggestions include lowering the age threshold for public interest directors from 75 to 70 years, instituting a maximum of two three-year terms for directors, and restricting managing directors to an eight-year tenure. Current executives can finish their ongoing terms despite these proposed changes. SEBI is seeking public feedback on these recommendations by December 11.

articles.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2% as Anthropic retreat deepens AI trade concerns
articles.desc: Following a rocky market debut, Anthropic’s stock price plunge led to a notable drop in the Nasdaq Composite index. The AI sector faces growing skepticism amidst high valuations and investment risks, putting pressure on major U.S. stock indexes. Despite some companies reporting strong earnings, investor anxiety persists over potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.

articles.title: No FAST-DS declaration needed for foreign bank a/c up to Rs 20 lakh with disclosed funds: I-T dept
articles.desc: The Income Tax Department has announced exemptions for individuals with foreign bank accounts under FAST-DS. Individuals with balances up to Rs 20 lakh from disclosed sources do not need to file declarations. This exemption applies as long as the accounts contain no undisclosed income or unaccounted deposits. The scheme provides a one-time opportunity to disclose foreign assets and income by December 31.

Rupee climbs past 93/USD as investors seek shelter in Indian stocks, shorts unwind
articles.desc: The Indian rupee has strengthened past the 93-per-dollar mark for the first time since April. This recovery is attributed to over $12 billion of foreign investments in Indian equities in November. Hedge funds have unwound bearish positions on the rupee, contributing to its recent gains. The Reserve Bank of India has taken measures to support the local currency amidst stabilization efforts.

articles.title: RBI expected to raise rates in December, deliver final hike in February: Report
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% in December and take it to 6% in February as inflation breaches its 6% tolerance limit, a Reuters poll showed. Rising energy costs and uneven monsoon rainfall have intensified inflationary pressures.

articles.title: India's capital goods market could reach $1.2 trillion by 2047, driven by data centres, chips: Report
articles.desc: India's capital goods market could expand to USD 1-1.2 trillion by 2047, driven by rising investments in data centres, semiconductors, defence and clean energy, a CII-BCG report said. Annual capital expenditure across major industries is projected to rise 30% to Rs 32 lakh crore by FY27-29.

articles.title: Anthropic's debut rally fades as shares crack 7% in US pre-market trade
articles.desc: Anthropic shares fell as much as 7.4% in premarket trading on their second day, as a global market selloff and concerns over the AI trade overshadowed the optimism surrounding its record-setting IPO debut. After surging 39% from the IPO price on Thursday, the stock ended 17% higher. A steep valuation and competitive threats added to investor caution.

articles.title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report
articles.desc: According to a new report, the appreciation of the Indian rupee could lead Indian IT companies to experience reduced earnings. The stronger rupee against foreign currencies may significantly impact profitability, especially for firms with substantial European exposure. As traditional cost-saving strategies grow scarce, maintaining margins will be a challenge, compounded by the current economic environment affecting pricing strategies in the industry.

articles.title: Sebi plans consultation paper to remove FPI constraints absent in other markets
articles.desc: SEBI is set to release a consultation paper aimed at simplifying regulations for foreign portfolio investors. The goal is to eliminate certain compliance restrictions to enhance India's appeal to global investors. SEBI also plans to expedite the onboarding process, targeting completion in just five business days. Additionally, KYC review cycles for applicable FPIs will be extended, reducing repetitive compliance activities.

articles.title: FM Sitharaman holds eighth pre-Budget consultation with labour, employment sector stakeholders
articles.desc: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the eighth pre-Budget consultation with employment and labour sector stakeholders on Friday, seeking inputs for the Union Budget 2027-28. The meeting follows consultations with infrastructure, energy, IT, banking and other sectors as the government prepares its annual Budget, scheduled to be presented on February 1, 2027.

articles.title: Indian finance hub eyes dual share model to kickstart public offers: Report
articles.desc: Indian regulators are currently assessing a new proposal that would allow companies to introduce dual-class shares for listings in both domestic markets and GIFT City. This initiative seeks to invigorate equity market activity in GIFT City, which has faced challenges regarding limited primary market participation. One class of shares would be traded in rupees, while the other would be dollar-denominated, granting foreign investors easier access alongside reduced tax implications.

India's wheat area set for steepest decline in 26 years as farmers switch crops
articles.desc: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains. Farmers are shifting to less water-intensive crops like chickpeas and rapeseed, which promise better returns. The government's minimal increase in wheat procurement prices has also discouraged wheat planting among farmers. As a result, wheat acreage is expected to drop to its lowest level in four years.

articles.title: Treasury rally spills over to Indian bonds, debt supply slows move
articles.desc: Indian government bonds saw slight gains, reflecting the upward trend in US Treasuries. Investors are keeping a close eye on the forthcoming weekly debt auction, pivotal for market movements. With retail inflation and fluctuating oil prices in play, the Reserve Bank of India may entertain further rate hikes. Although benchmark Brent crude holds steady, it remains vulnerable to geopolitical shifts, prompting caution among traders as they await auction results.

articles.title: Rupee rises past 93 vs USD as portfolio inflows, bear retreat fuel rally
articles.desc: The Indian rupee has shown remarkable strength, breaking the 93 per dollar barrier for the first time since April. This positive shift was fueled by impressive foreign portfolio investments, exceeding $12 billion in November alone. Consequently, the rupee has left its Asian peers behind as it thrives against a strong dollar, all while navigating the Federal Reserve's anticipated hawkish stance, showcasing an encouraging signal for the Indian market.

articles.title: Rupee strengthens 17 paise to 93.15 against US dollar in early trade
articles.desc: Rupee gained 17 paise to trade at 93.15 against the US dollar in early trade on Friday. The appreciation was supported by strong foreign fund inflows into the domestic equity markets. Despite higher crude prices and negative stock market sentiment, the currency showed resilience. Analysts expect slight positive bias in rupee trading due to declining crude and gold prices.
